sources.title: GitHub - Mixar-AI/mixar-app: AI-powered 3D suite built on Blender, with ...
sources.snippet: Mixar is an AI-powered 3D content creation tool built as a custom fork of Blender 5.0. It adds an AI chat agent that can drive Blender, a layered texture-painting system, AI-assisted 3D generation, and a set of Mixar-native editor spaces — while keeping everything you already use from Blender.
